title: a failing destroy is reported as a failure
purpose: The program terminates unsuccessfully after the observable effects listed.

failure.justification: The failing destroy uses a bare confirm, whose category is runtime or panic (D-004).

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.5: if a destroy block fails, the runtime reports the failure.
